PROVENANCE: every value here was extracted from PM-supplied HTML prototypes
on 2026-08-04 (see docs/index.md, 'PM prototype set'). These are DESIGN

sources: Ding App - White & Blue Launch V2 (Fixed, Standalone).html
meta.$comment_brand: Model strings below carry the 'Ding' brand from the prototypes. The product is currently named NOMA. Renaming every SKU is blocked on C-2.

$comment_firstRun: Only these four are offered during first-device setup in the prototype. Lights, speakers and sensors appear in strategy material only.

devices.$comment: Appears in the seeded device list only. No spec, no price, and no stated difference from X1.

$comment: Not NOMA devices — companion hardware from the parent brand's existing line.
They are SIGNAL SOURCES, not controllable devices. The integration is a real
differentiator: it ties air quality to a body metric, which is what stops air

triggers.label: Sleep detected
triggers.source: low activity + HR in sleep range

wearables.openQuestion: C-8 — an SpO2-triggered purifier boost is a health-adjacent inference. The prototype presents it as an ordinary automation. Needs a medical and legal position before it ships.

sensing.$comment: How air data is actually produced. This is the substance behind the product's central claim.

measures.note: Shown as Low/Med/High, never a number
Appears in Score factors only. Which SKU carries a CO2 sensor is unstated — see C-9.

outdoor.source: CPCB (Central Pollution Control Board) — nearest station
outdoor.$comment: Verbatim from the prototype: 'Outdoor values blended from the nearest CPCB station.' The blend is specified nowhere. That matters, because the indoor-vs-outdoor comparison is the product's core emotional beat and every number in it depends on this.

connectivity.pairing: Bluetooth LE — device powered on, phone held close
connectivity.notableBehaviour: Setup deliberately HIDES 5 GHz SSIDs the device cannot join, rather than listing them and failing. Worth preserving: it removes the single most common smart-home setup failure.
connectivity.firmware: OTA; version shown in device settings (prototype: v2.4.1)

modes.$comment: CONFLICT C-4 — three incompatible fan-mode vocabularies across the source docs. NOT reconciled. Do not build mode UI until this is ruled.

homeScenes.$comment: A distinct concept from fan modes — whole-home scenes. Consistent across all docs.

$comment: THE CORE DIFFERENTIATOR. Competitors count runtime hours; NOMA weights each
hour by the particulate load actually absorbed. Same filter, same hours, in
Delhi versus Mumbai, yields materially different remaining life.
This is the one claim the whole product is built on, and it is currently
filterModel.claimedEffect: Above AQI 200 a filter absorbs 3-5x more particulate per hour than on clean-air days.
filterModel.alerting: Predictive — surfaces before failure, with reorder timed to arrive before exhaustion.
filterModel.specStatus: UNSPECIFIED — no formula, no coefficients, no validation data supplied. Tracked as C-7.
